title: Design system
purpose: Color/type/depth consistency, not a new visual direction.
responsive: Native text and controls sit on reusable material skins.

title: Component states
purpose: Shared controls across all screens, including unavailable and pending.
responsive: Focused and selected are distinct contracts; final focus uses a dual cream/plum outline, not color alone.

title: Motion storyboard
purpose: A storyboard of intended feel, not an implemented animation.
responsive: No whole-screen bounce, loops or animation-gated input.

title: Home
purpose: One-screen game menu with a single primary Play action.
responsive: Remove optional summary/decorative area before text or actions. No page scroll in any mode.

title: Controls
purpose: Brief playable input explanation, no quiz or forced purchase.
responsive: Same rules, hardware-specific controls. Review from Settings. Local intent demonstration only.

title: Quick Play queue
purpose: One queue, no unnecessary mode selector or Ready page.
responsive: Cancel stays visible. Animation never delays cancellation. Countdown is an authoritative/mocked event, not a local matchmaking simulation.

title: Countdown
purpose: One queue, no unnecessary mode selector or Ready page.
responsive: Cancel stays visible. Animation never delays cancellation. Countdown is an authoritative/mocked event, not a local matchmaking simulation.

title: MAKE IT YOURS
purpose: Select a real catalog cosmetic; inspect before equipping or buying.
responsive: Portrait replaces the large always-visible preview with an item sheet. The grid alone may scroll; tabs and action dock are fixed.

title: Item details
purpose: Honest cosmetic inspection with its source collection preserved.
responsive: Phone uses a safe-area sheet with pinned Close and action row; long description scrolls inside only.

title: COSMETIC SHOP
purpose: Select a real catalog cosmetic; inspect before equipping or buying.
responsive: Portrait replaces the large always-visible preview with an item sheet. The grid alone may scroll; tabs and action dock are fixed.

title: Purchase confirm
purpose: Purchase status without duplicate charges or false refunds.
responsive: Short phone copy, pinned buttons, controller focus starts on Cancel. Closing presentation cannot cancel an already-submitted write.

title: Purchase pending
purpose: Purchase status without duplicate charges or false refunds.
responsive: Short phone copy, pinned buttons, controller focus starts on Cancel. Closing presentation cannot cancel an already-submitted write.

title: Purchase unknown
purpose: Purchase status without duplicate charges or false refunds.
responsive: Short phone copy, pinned buttons, controller focus starts on Cancel. Closing presentation cannot cancel an already-submitted write.

title: Profile
purpose: Only supported profile totals, without invented levels or ranks.
responsive: Identity remains readable. Optional later history is separate content, not a longer Home.

title: Settings
purpose: Real audio/readability preferences with clear save state.
responsive: Category tabs and Back fixed; only settings rows may scroll. 150% text version allocates taller rows rather than scaling down the full screen.

title: Match HUD
purpose: Keep trails and cores dominant, with two steering directions only.
responsive: No shop/menu rail. Touch controls use bottom-corner 64px targets, to be verified against actual playfield sightlines. Time is elapsed, no new hard round limit. Spectator cycling deferred.
